Santa Clara Pueblo

Santa Clara is a distinct Tewa Pueblo in northern New Mexico. Its own historical account connects the living community with ancestral Puje, while its Forestry Department describes sustained work on forests and the Santa Clara Canyon watershed after the 2011 Las Conchas fire.

03

Ancestral places and a living community

Santa Clara’s About page relates the present Pueblo to ancestral Puje and emphasizes respect for language, history and the surrounding landscape. This is its public account of continuity and community values. It neither opens private cultural knowledge nor replaces a fuller history based on additional community sources.

Read the sources [4] Santa Clara Pueblo

04

Restoring a fire-damaged watershed

The Forestry Department describes watershed effects of the 2011 Las Conchas fire followed by erosion, debris flows and flooding. It explains forest health, reforestation, channel stability and flood-mitigation work with partners. Reported goals and activities do not establish complete recovery or current canyon access.

Read the sources [5] Santa Clara Pueblo
